name: Delete Rows
description: Deletes the specified rows from a spreadsheet. [See the documentation](https://developers.google.com/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request#deletedimensionrequest)

configurable_props.name: drive
configurable_props.label: Drive
configurable_props.description: The drive containing the spreadsheet to edit. If you are connected with any [Google Shared Drives](https://support.google.com/a/users/answer/9310351), you can select it here.

configurable_props.name: sheetId
configurable_props.label: Spreadsheet ID
configurable_props.description: Select a spreadsheet or provide a spreadsheet ID

configurable_props.name: worksheetId
configurable_props.label: Worksheet ID
configurable_props.description: Select a worksheet or provide a worksheet ID

configurable_props.name: startIndex
configurable_props.label: Start Index
configurable_props.description: Row number of the start (inclusive) of the range of rows to delete

configurable_props.name: endIndex
configurable_props.label: End Index
configurable_props.description: Row number of the end (exclusive) of the range of rows to delete
